PRIVACY

Define the purpose.
Then handle the data.

The public product pages do not require an account. Reservations and payments are currently closed.

Public pages

You do not need to enter a name, address, or card details to browse the product pages. Fonts and visual assets are served from this site rather than requested from a third-party font provider. Access logs retained by the hosting platform for secure operation are governed by the hosting provider's operating terms.

After sales open

If sales begin, we will handle only the information needed to process an order, such as the order number, product, amount, accepted terms version, timestamp, payment state, and external payment identifier. Card details will be processed by an external payment provider and will not be stored in this site's order database.

Contact

Seller details and a direct contact method will be published in Sales terms before sales open. Questions about the current project can be sent to Instagram @kirin.41.
